metadata.title: Macroscopic Poincaré Inequalities and Weak-Type Characterizations of $p$-Energy Forms
metadata.abstract: For a class of regular strongly local $p$-energy forms on complete doubling metric measure spaces, $1<p<\infty$, we derive a macroscopic Poincaré inequality from a Poincaré inequality and a capacity upper bound at a doubling scale $\Psi$. The macroscopic inequality compares $L^p$-oscillations at any two scales and yields a uniform two-scale comparison $J_s\lesssim J_r$, $0<r<s$, for the Korevaar-Schoen functionals, strengthening their usual weak monotonicity property. Conversely, under a density assumption on compactly supported functions, the macroscopic inequality yields a regular strongly local Korevaar-Schoen $p$-energy satisfying a $\Psi$-Poincaré inequality. We also show that the macroscopic inequality forces lower $p$-scaling of $\Psi$ on scales not exceeding $\mathrm{diam} X$; together with doubling, this gives two-sided power bounds. Finally, we establish a weak-type characterization of the energy domain of Brezis-Van Schaftingen-Yung type.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在完备倍增度量测度空间建立跨任意两尺度的宏观 Poincaré 不等式，并刻画 p-能量域。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到比通常弱单调性更强的统一两尺度比较，并在密度条件下反向构造满足 Poincaré 不等式的能量。
analysis.limitations: 限定 1<p<∞；正反向结论分别依赖容量尺度、倍增性及紧支撑函数密度，不能省略。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
